purpose: Evidence-backed recovery queue for historical LOC5 media. Threads life-writing posts are searched for Suno/media links, then cross-checked against LOC3 song data and LOC5 media registry. A Suno link alone proves a song reference, not an Instagram/YouTube media asset.
recovery_method: search LOC4 Threads source text for Suno/share/media URLs
cross-match Suno share URL against LOC3 song/version records
cross-match known IG/YouTube links against LOC3_MEDIA_LINKS and LOC_MEDIA_REGISTRY
promote to LOC5 media only when an actual media URL or explicit media evidence exists
otherwise retain as candidate/evidence and do not invent a Reel/MV link

source_scope.note: The current representative tranche already contains recoverable Suno references; full 4,578-main-post corpus should be mined next for broader LOC5 recovery.

governance_rule: Author-provided exact Suno↔Instagram URLs may become LOC5 media evidence. Missing URLs remain missing; unresolved content verification stays under_review rather than being silently promoted.

primary_source.name: LOC3_LOC5_影音連結整合清單
primary_source.rule: same song multiple Reels preserved; different song_id versions kept separate; blanks never guessed
